xmldoc.short_description: Bessel function of the third kind (Hankel function).

param_input_item.param_description: 1 (default) for the first kind, 2 for the second kind.
0 (default) or 1 to return the scaled values.

description.p: besselh(nu, K, Z) computes the Hankel function of the first kind (K = 1), J + iY, or of the second kind (K = 2), J - iY, for each element of NU and Z. besselh(nu, Z) uses K = 1.
besselh(nu, K, Z, 1) returns besselh(nu, K, Z) .* exp(-1i * Z) for K = 1 and besselh(nu, K, Z) .* exp(1i * Z) for K = 2.
NU and Z must have the same size, or one of them can be a scalar.
The result is single when an input is single, and real when every imaginary part is zero.
Values are computed with a C++ port of the Amos algorithms, for any real order and any complex argument.

xmldoc.bibliography: D. E. Amos, Algorithm 644: A portable package for Bessel functions of a complex argument and nonnegative order, ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software, 12 (1986), pp. 265-273.
